'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Brian Hunter DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck title It's All Greek To Me. Line 9 Evader & Monnok scratched; kept for 60. Sheet lists 10 shields.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
